# ComPDF

Convert, generate, edit, parse, and extract data from documents with ComPDF's global cloud API.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/compdf/.

## Actions

- **Add PDF Watermark**: Add a text or image watermark to selected pages of one PDF.
- **Compress PDF**: Compress one PDF with typed document and image optimization controls.
- **Convert Document**: Convert one PDF, office document, text file, CSV, HTML file, RTF file, or image to a supported output format, synchronously or as an…
- **Convert PDF Standard**: Convert one PDF to a supported PDF/A, PDF/X-4, or PDF/E-1 standard using the required ICC color profile.
- **Convert PDF to PDF/UA**: Convert one PDF to the PDF/UA-1 accessibility standard, optionally embedding a document title and language.
- **Decrypt PDF**: Decrypt one password-protected PDF.
- **Delete PDF Pages**: Create a new PDF with selected pages removed.
- **Encrypt PDF**: Encrypt one PDF with at least a user password or owner password and optional permission controls.
- **Extract Document Fields**: Extract one fixed field schema from an uploaded document with ComPDF.
- **Extract PDF Pages**: Extract selected pages from one PDF into a new PDF.
- **Get Account Quota** (read-only): Return available and withheld ComPDF processing balances for the connected project account.
- **Get Task** (read-only): Get the current status, aggregate counts, and per-file results for one ComPDF processing task.
- **List Supported Operations** (read-only): List the document-processing operation routes currently advertised by ComPDF.
- **List Tasks** (read-only): Return one page of processing-task history for the connected ComPDF project.
- **Parse Document**: Run ComPDF's full intelligent parsing on one uploaded document.
- **Remove PDF Watermark**: Remove tagged or untagged watermarks from selected pages of one PDF.
- **Rotate PDF Pages**: Rotate selected pages in one PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- **Split PDF**: Split selected pages from one PDF into separate files in a ZIP archive.
- **Wait For Task** (read-only): Poll a ComPDF processing task at a safe interval until it finishes, expires, fails, or reaches a caller-supplied timeout.
